title: RequirePrimitive
description: Declarative condition evaluation gate for physical commodities, spatial locations, and personal actor attributes.

step_id.description: Unique identifier for this pipeline step.

domain.description: Domain of inspection: COMMODITY checks inventory; LOCATION checks spatial presence; ATTRIBUTE checks actor metrics.

actor.description: Entity token to evaluate (e.g. ORDER_ACTOR, INITIATOR, or specific entity ID).

metric.description: Commodity token (e.g. CASH), location attribute (e.g. current_district_id), or actor metric (e.g. fatigue).

value.description: Static numeric/string threshold or dynamic symbol (e.g. CALCULATED_TOTAL_COST, PARAM.amount, PARAM.target_node_id).

error_code.description: Explicit failure code from EngineResult.ErrorCode (e.g. PAYMENT_REQUIRED, OUT_OF_STOCK, INVALID_TARGET).

extra_time_spent.description: Operational minutes wasted upon gate bounce.

extra_fatigue.description: Fatigue penalty applied to operative upon gate bounce.

next_step.description: ID of next step on pass, or null to terminate pipeline.
